gate4.rationale: The SEC 8-K item 2.02 plus strict gap/hold/high-close candidate definition produced only 11 raw candidates across the canonical three windows before paper trade construction, so a Gate 4 strategy replay would not have statistical meaning.

hypothesis: PIT-safe SEC 8-K item 2.02 results filings that also gap up, hold the gap, trade high volume, and close near the high may identify a cleaner post-results continuation candidate pool than raw SEC filing reaction.
next_retry_requires: Do not retry strict 8-K 2.02 gap/hold/high-close on the frozen windows.
A valid SEC results retry needs either a less sparse but pre-registered filing-quality field, XBRL financial-quality context, or forward event rows.
If promoted later, implement SEC filing features in a shared production/backtest module before changing any live path.

parameters.required_ohlcv_confirmation: gap_up >= 3%, intraday return >= 0, close_location >= 0.75, volume_ratio_20 >= 1.5, ret20_excess_spy >= 2%, avg_dollar_volume_20 >= $100M
